description: Four predicted human ratings of the clip, each on a scale of about 1 to 10 (higher is more), averaged over 10-second windows by their length.

CE.description: Content Enjoyment: how enjoyable the content is.

CU.description: Content Usefulness: how useful the clip would be as source material for making content.

PC.description: Production Complexity: how many sound sources and layers it has (1 is a single plain source).

PQ.description: Production Quality: technical quality, such as clarity, noise, dynamics and frequency balance.

seconds.description: Length of the clip in seconds.
